data.name: Saaliha
data.gender_notes: Saaliha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A virtuous and intelligent female, who is wise and knowledgeable, with a deep understanding of the world and its complexities. The name Saaliha carries the meaning “Prudent, wise, intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Saaliha usually hope their child will grow to embody prudent, wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islam, Saaliha is the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), known for her wisdom, courage, and devotion to Islam.
data.etymology: Saaliha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prudent, wise, intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saaliha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hindi.name: सालीहा
in_hindi.long_meaning: सालीहा : यह एक अरबी शब्द है जो कुरान में भी प्रयोग किया गया है। इसका अर्थ है पाक, सलाह, अच्छा, खलिस, सलीम। इस शब्द के अलावा यह भी प्रयोग होता है कि एक व्यक्ति जो पाक, सलाह, अच्छा, खलिस, सलीम हो। इस्लाम में यह एक अच्छी गुणवत्ता मानी जाती है।

in_english.name: Saaliha
in_english.meaning: Purified, virtuous, righteous, wholesome, salutary, pure, and intact
in_english.long_meaning: Saaliha is an Arabic name that conveys the meaning of purity, virtue, righteousness, wholesomeness, salutarity, and intactness. It is derived from the Arabic root "s-l-h," which means to be pure, clean, and free from impurities. In Islamic tradition, Saaliha is considered a praiseworthy quality, associated with individuals who possess good character, integrity, and a strong sense of justice. The name Saaliha is also related to the concept of "salih," which refers to a person who is righteous, virtuous, and pious. In modern times, the name Saaliha has become popular in many Muslim cultures, symbolizing a woman who is pure, virtuous, and righteous.
